models.note: Kimi K3.1 Pro and its highspeed variant share the K3 contract: always-on thinking, no thinking switch, and low/high/max reasoning_effort.
Kimi K3 always thinks and is controlled only via the top-level reasoning_effort with fixed low/high/max tiers.
kimi-k2.7-code (including -highspeed) does not support the thinking.type switch; the empty declare shadows the K2.5/K2.6 switch record and the unknown-version default below.
Kimi K2.6 supports thinking.type enabled/disabled; retain the existing K2.5 legacy switch declaration. K2.7-code is excluded above.
Unknown Kimi versions default to the current K3/K3.1 Pro contract: no thinking switch and only low/high/max reasoning_effort.
